meta_description:
599K likes, 2,057 comments - ilunarang on December 31, 2022: "This is undoubtedly the most insanely blue water I have ever seen in my entire life! 🙌 
This is Zanzibar ❤️

It is an island off the East coast in Tanzania and has Visa on Arrival for Indians. It is far cheaper than Maldives and has incredible experiences to offer-

- Luxurious accommodations
- World class beaches
- Some do the best snorkelling and dive sites in the world 
- Dolphin watching tours
- Sunset cruise
- History, culture and the most fun people I’ve ever met

I’ve been to Zanzibar twice and I still miss it every day! It is slowly getting popular in Indian tourists now. 

If you have questions please feel free to ask in the comments 😄

#zanzibarbeach #zanzibarisland #zanzibarofficial #zanzibardestination #tanzaniatourism #indiangirlstravel #indiantravellers #thrillophilia #travelxp".
